entries.title: Psalms 21:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

entries.title: Psalms 21:2
segments: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 21:3
segments: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.

entries.title: Psalms 21:4
segments: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 21:5
segments: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.

entries.title: Psalms 21:6
segments: For thou makest him most blessed for ever: Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.

entries.title: Psalms 21:7
segments: For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 21:8
segments: Thy hand will find out all thine enemies; Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.

entries.title: Psalms 21:9
segments: Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger: Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath, And the fire shall devour them.

entries.title: Psalms 21:10
segments: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 21:11
segments: For they intended evil against thee; They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.

entries.title: Psalms 21:12
segments: For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.

entries.title: Psalms 21:13
segments: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.
